items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I had married this girl, Freddie Washington

ctx.x: Still during the Depression years? That's sort of the end of the Depression?

Sort of the end of the Depression, yes. Because by this time I had gone East and gotten married. I had married this girl, Freddie Washington, that did one of the lead roles in "Imitation of Life." And that was the apartment that we had in California. So everything was so nice then. You never heard anything like three and four hundred dollars a month for a one room, bedroom. So it was really nice, really beautiful out here.
Did your family ever get used to the idea of your being a musician? Did your father ever feel any differently?
